findings.title: Remove pure administrative penalties from focus progression
findings.fact: defence_accounts is 21 days for +2% bureaucracy and no unlock. society_literacy_accounts is 35 days plus 0.5% GDP for +1% bureaucracy and no unlock. industry_survey is 21 days for +2% bureaucracy and a queue-inspection decision. These have no direct positive numerical reward.
findings.proposal: Merge the survey and accounting steps into the following substantive project. If retained: defence_accounts grants 20 Army XP and removes its +2% bureaucracy; society_literacy_accounts grants one 25% CAT_industry research bonus, removes its +1% bureaucracy and retains 0.5% GDP payment; industry_survey is a 14-day free inspection/unlock, with no permanent malus. These are alternatives to consolidation, not cumulative grants.

findings.title: Stop selling stability that the global cap discards
findings.fact: Positive policy Stability is capped at +0.15 across all eligible programmes; negatives remain in full. Once the sum is already >=0.15, another purely positive Stability contribution changes its allocation but cannot increase the national sum. state_compact gives +0.03 Stability after 49 days and a constitutional review unlock. Many political end focuses also give only +0.03 Stability plus PP/cost modifiers.
findings.proposal: Keep the cap. Replace late duplicated positive Stability with distinct institutional payoffs. state_compact: bureaucracy -0.06 and tax collection +0.04, no additional Stability, 49 days and unchanged review unlock. baath_future: keep +0.03 PP, replace +0.02 bureaucracy with one 25% CAT_industry bonus. bakr_succession_plan: keep political/transition function, replace +0.03 Stability with +25 command power only if a direct command-power consumer is useful; otherwise shorten to 21 days and retain its actual transition options. Do not manufacture another hidden global bonus cap.
findings.status: cap arithmetic confirmed; bundles proposed; command power requires campaign-use check

findings.title: Replace global small research bonuses with useful specialist research rewards
findings.fact: All 426 approved focus payloads together contain zero add_tech_bonus and zero add_doctrine_cost_reduction effects; 25 contain global research_speed_factor. Main MD explicitly uses specialist one-time research bonuses from 10% to 100%, often 25-50%, with 1-2 uses.
findings.proposal: industry_machine_tools: replace +1% global research with two 35% CAT_industry uses; keep +3% efficiency cap and 2.5% GDP. society_technical_colleges: replace +3% global research with one 50% CAT_construction and one 25% CAT_industry use; keep +3% social expenditure and 3% GDP. defence_air_maintenance: replace +2% global research with one 35% CAT_aircraft use and 15 Air XP; retain +2% bureaucracy and 2.5% GDP. defence_staff_training: 15 -> 35 Army XP and one 25% land_doctrine cost reduction; retain existing +3% organisation,+4% training time and 2% GDP. Verify the downstream technology is visible/unresearched in the actual 1970 save; no free ahead-of-time bypass.
findings.status: counts and native providers confirmed; balance proposals

findings.title: Make headline exclusive options desirable before their subordinate foci
findings.fact: 46 exclusive pairs already exist, but many compare +2-5% generic modifiers. industry_heavy is +3% efficiency cap/+2% consumer-goods factor; industry_light is +3% efficiency growth/-2% military factory output. defence_professional is +4% organisation/+6% personnel costs; defence_mass is +6% conscription_factor/-3% organisation. These are not necessarily strictly dominated because descendants and constraints differ, but their headline strategic differences are weak.
findings.proposal: Use the six complete pairs below rather than increasing every minor reward. Show the branch-specific one-time payoff and enduring policy on the actual choice focus. Audit the complete reachable branch, not just its first node.
findings.status: current values confirmed; qualitative balance finding

findings.title: Fix cost/reward tempo rather than simply giving every focus more buildings
findings.fact: The entire Industry catalogue totals 34.5% GDP in frozen one-time invoices, agriculture 30%, oil 29%, society 28%, defence 29.5%. These totals include both mutually exclusive branches and are not a payable single-route bill. A building is granted only after its invoice, control and capacity checks pass. Some offers have additional distinct payments. Industry branch has 686 listed focus-days including alternatives.
findings.proposal: Consolidate industry_quality and industry_maintenance into one 35-day 2% GDP package: +8% efficiency growth,+2% maximum efficiency,-1% military factory output,+2% bureaucracy. Replace the remaining node with the specialist training bonus in M03 or remove it with preserved existing-save receipts. For defence_readiness: keep the 49-day unlock only if it also gives one-time 25 Army XP. Change its recurring 2% GDP/90-day +3% organisation/+4% army costs cycle to a 0.5% GDP/90-day +8% organisation,+8% recovery,+4% army costs cycle with unchanged 180-day cooldown. No repeatable XP.
findings.status: invoice semantics and costs confirmed; no campaign affordability forecast claimed

findings.title: Give recurring bureaucracy taxes a specific purpose and a route to completion
findings.fact: 148 of 426 focus payloads modify bureaucracy expenditure, overwhelmingly adding +1-6% as a generic downside. 88 modify PP and 136 Stability. The pattern makes very different ideologies feel mechanically similar and can leave reforms more administratively expensive without a visible service improvement. MD reader multiplies the bureaucracy spending array by 1 + modifier; it does not directly raise tax receipts or improve institutions.
findings.proposal: Use a small number of explicit funded institutions instead of a new permanent bureaucracy malus on every step. Example: courts_budget becomes one 35-day 1.5% GDP package tax +0.05, bureaucracy +0.02. budget_accounts becomes tax +0.04 and bureaucracy -0.03, 0.5% GDP, replacing its PP -0.02. Preserve non-identical historical tradeoffs; do not stack this example with an unchanged final state_compact reward until whole-route totals are recalculated.
findings.status: reader/count confirmed; proposals need net-route budget

findings.title: Do not mistake export and relative-cost modifiers for production or percentage points
findings.fact: oil_export_multiplier_modifier feeds exported oil quantity times market price times additive export multiplier. It produces no benefit without actual oil exports, and creates neither resources nor infrastructure. consumer_goods_factor multiplies consumer_goods_expected_value; +0.02 is a 2% relative factor, not +2 percentage points of factories. army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier multiplies the army wage component, not every military expense or all national expenditure.
findings.proposal: For an oil-export path, retain genuine exports as the main incentive but pair it with real infrastructure/refining research so embargoed Iraq has a meaningful alternative. Use the oil pair below. Preserve the existing exceptionally expensive actual Iran-war wage/equipment escalation; do not describe a +6% ordinary focus wage modifier as the mechanism that creates that crisis.

findings.title: Keep strong territorial/crisis payoffs and improve decision-unlock staging
findings.fact: The 1970 package already includes actual Khuzestan claim/war goal/core and Kuwait invasion/core/debt-crisis relief. US Gulf focuses intentionally unlock consent-dependent operations; they are not all empty numeric foci. Desert Storm grants its actual liberation war goal in 14 days. Northern air readiness already gives +15% interception,+10% air superiority efficiency,+15% air personnel costs for90days, and accepted recipient cover gives +25%CASdamage reduction/-20%enemy air-superiority effect/+5%army personnel costs.

findings.proposal: Do not inflate these existing major prizes. In the US tree, merge contacts plus appeal if their separate completion only adds extra clicks before the same paid intervention. Make limited_war versus arm_front a visibly consequential commitment: limited_war may offer a consent-based 30-day actual war/ceasefire negotiation channel plus recipient-paid reconstruction; arm_front retains the actual weapons/underground budget and risks rebellion. No automatic peace, unwilling allies, free troops or remote air ban. Preserve all current genuine crisis and consent gates. Exact new diplomatic costs require the historical/MP review before implementation.
